description:
Navigate to Slide 2 ('Hardware Cost Calculator') and insert a LibreOffice Spreadsheet OLE Object. Inside the embedded spreadsheet, create a table with the following headers and data:

| Item | Unit Cost | Qty | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dell PowerEdge R750 | 8500 | 4 | [Formula] |
| Cisco Catalyst 9300 | 4200 | 6 | [Formula] |
| NetApp Storage Array | 12000 | 1 | [Formula] |

Use formulas to calculate the 'Total' column (Cost * Qty) and add a 'Grand Total' row at the bottom summing the totals. The Grand Total should be 71,200. Save the presentation when finished.
